design: Audit all inventory members of the four frozen M8/M20 archives against archive SHA-256, per-member SHA-256, type, date and exposure. Classify frames using FITS IMAGETYP first. Treat RA/DEC as object metadata, not an independent plate measurement. Exclude opaque dark/bias and illumination flats as optical background. No separate sky pointing or linked blank-sky control can be asserted by target light metadata alone. Report any other pointing separately; do not use chronology alone to claim co-observation.
containmentBasis: One degree is smaller than the roughly 1.16 degree minimum half width of the 6248 by 4176 detector at the archived nominal plate scale of 1.99885 arcsec/px. The check is a metadata screen, not a pointing solution or independent sky-reference certification.
